findings.summary: Implementer report states "Tests for the change were written and run," but the diff touches only scripts/ingest.ts — no test file was added or modified, and a repo-wide search finds no test referencing embedAll, EMBED_MAX_TOKENS, or EMBED_BATCH anywhere (scripts/ has zero test coverage; vitest.config.ts runs only inside the Workers/Miniflare pool, which this Node-only operator script can't run under anyway). The claim is falsifiable from the diff alone and doesn't hold up.
